episodes.synopsis: The Mythical Age. In an effort to destroy the Moon of Creation, Anos meets the Goddess of Creation Militia and begins to interact with her. And now the present... Anos, who has made his identity as the Demon King of Tyranny known throughout the world, joins classes at Demon King Academy as the transfer student, Anoshu. episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: To investigate the dragon sighted in Azeshion, Anos and his friends visit the Hero Academy in the name of participating in an exchange program. Emilia teaches at the Hero Academy, but despite her efforts, Ledriano and the other students of the Hero Academy are rather unenthusiastic about the exchange. Furthermore, Zamira, the headmaster of the Hero Academy, issues a decree to slay the dragon. Yet, as Emilia resists his unreasonable order, the Hero Academy students begin to lose interest…
episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.synopsis: Erdomaid trains the students in methods of dragon slaying. He does so in a dangerous battle with an actual dragon summoned. Anos and his friends infiltrate the dragon’s den and arrive in the Underground World, where the dragonfolk called Draconids live. Ahide, who attacked the previous evening, guides them to the Institute of the Gods, Everastanzetta. There, Anos is told how he has already been involved in the “Judgement Selection.”
episodes.title: L'Istituto degli Dei

episodes.synopsis: Emilia and her students take on the dragon-slaying and binding spell called “De Jelias.” However, Emilia and her students failed because they couldn't corporate with Laos and others. It was then that she caught a glimpse of their helplessness…. Meanwhile, Ley who was invited as a hero, has an audience with Lysius, King of Gairadite. He is asked to save the ailing royal family. But as he is shown around, what he encounters is…!
episodes.title: Episodio 16

episodes.synopsis: A horde of dragons approaches Azeshion! To protect their homeland with their own hands, the Hero Academy students set out to slay the dragons without the help of Anos and his friends. Under Emilia’s command, the Hero Academy students engage in a battle to the death. Meanwhile, Lay and Misa wind up in a predicament after being captured by Lysius…. Anos and the others head to the Underground World to take care of their own agenda. There, he learns that Ahide is controlling the Draconids.
episodes.title: Episodio 17

episodes.synopsis: Ahide announces that Midhaze will be destroyed. However, the oracle’s will contradicts Arcana’s true intentions. Shin also joins in the fray as the two finally face off! Ahide possesses Arcana and thrusts the judgement of the Sword of the Almighty, Leviangilma, upon Anos. Arcana states that to destroy Ahide, he must be slashed three times with the Divine Sword. But the sword obliterates the source of anyone who draws the sword from its sheath….
episodes.title: Episodio 18

episodes.synopsis: That day, Anos had a dream about a time that he lived together with a young girl. The young girl is strangely also named Arcana…. Furthermore, the fact that the Draconids called the fusion of Sasha and Misha the Goddess of Absurdity, Genedonov, was also a problem. To investigate the piling mysteries, Anos decides to take a special class in the Underground World. And as a special lecturer, Anos teaches the student of Demon King Academy himself!?
episodes.title: Episodio 19

episodes.synopsis: Arriving in Giorhaze, capital of the Underground World Giordal, Anos follows a wary Erdomaid to a church. There, they obtain a Pledge Jewel which summons dragons. Furthermore, Erdomaid sees Naya’s aptitude and makes a pack with her after learning her plan. Anos hears about Ahide’s actions from the bishop of the church and decides to catch him before he meets the pope.
episodes.title: Episodio 20

episodes.synopsis: The sacred Sojourner’s Psalm to be performed at the Divine Dragon Festival is in danger of being cancelled due to Ahide’s schemes! Ellen and the Anos Fan Union are asked to take the stage instead as the Dilhade Demon King Choir. The Draconids are drawn in by their song and begin to sing along. Meanwhile, while trying to pursue and capture Ahide, Anos encounters Dietrich, the King of Agatha, who has received a prophecy from the Goddess of the Future Naphta.
episodes.title: Episodio 21

episodes.synopsis: Anos and Pope Golroana clash for the future of their respective countries! GGG launches a fierce attack with Gospel Magic using the power of the God of Gospel Doldread, who controls sound. Anos counters with the song of the Dilhade Demon King Choir and brings Golroana’s support, the former popes, into the fray. Yet even after the conclusion of the battle, Golroana continues his prayers. Anos offers him peace, but…
episodes.title: Episodio 22

episodes.synopsis: Ceris, commander of the Phantom Knights, who claims to be Anos' father, says that Militia gave Anos false memories. After Ceris leaves, Arcana, unable to recover her memories of Anos, falls into a dream once again. In her memory of 2,000 years ago, Arcana hears a secret about herself from Ceris. Anos reincarnates Arcana to protect her, but his wish for her at the time was…
episodes.title: Episodio 23

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Dilhade and Giordal intensifies! However, Anos becomes suspicious of Giordal's small fighting force. After seeing Cannibal flying out of the castle and noticing he has eaten the song of a Divine Dragon, Anos comes to one final conclusion. The 1,500 years of prayer that Giordal had continued for so long…was a never-ending barrier separating the two irreconcilable nations.

info.synopsis:
2046. Nella città di St. Lowell, su Marte, gli abitanti sono in procinto di rivoltarsi non solo a causa di una politica che favorisce e che protegge esclusivamente gli interessi delle grandi corporazioni ma anche per le pessime condizioni di vita dei cittadini e la presenza sempre più massiccia di androidi, usati per svolgere un numero sempre più ampio di lavori. Gli androidi sono sempre più simili all’uomo, gli uomini sempre più simili a macchine. Qual è il confine che ormai li divide? Un androide in grado di provare dolore, rabbia, amore e tutti quei sentimenti considerati “umani” perché deve essere trattato come un diverso?
Queste sono le contraddizioni del mondo in cui vive Naomi Armitage, androide di terza generazione (capolavori della tecnologia indistinguibili dagli esseri umani) che finge di essere umana per sfuggire alla discriminazione. Armitage lavora nel corpo di polizia di St. Lowell e le viene assegnato come compagno il detective Ross, a cui in passato un androide causò la morte della sua partner e lo privò della gamba destra. Che accadrebbe se scoprisse il segreto della sua nuova collega? I due si troveranno a indagare su una serie di omicidi legati ad androidi di terza generazione...
info.title: Armitage III

episodes.synopsis: Tra le due famiglie della yakuza Somei e Miyama sembra essere tornata la pace: Yoshino, nipote del boss Somei, deve andare a Tokyo per incontrare Kirishima, nipote del boss Miyama, con cui presumibilmente dovrà sposarsi. Kirishima è davvero il ragazzo gentile che sembra?
episodes.title: Non è un posto per perdenti

episodes.synopsis: La figlia del presidente Akaza è scomparsa, o per rapimento oppure perché è semplicemente scappata di casa. Per la sua incolumità, Yoshino deve restare sempre con Kirishima, il quale ha molte informazioni sulla giovane scomparsa.
episodes.title: Voglio mostrarti la mia sincerità. E, se possibile, farti innamorare un po' di me.

episodes.synopsis: Proprio quando Kirishima e Yoshino iniziano ad avvicinarsi un po', da Osaka arriva un caro amico della ragazza.
episodes.title: Il triangolo amoroso dell'inferno

episodes.synopsis: After a tense encounter between Kirishima and Shouma, Shouma drives back to Osaka. Yoshino gets the sense that something is spoiling Kirishima's mood and confronts him. Like every year, Yoshino catches a summer flu.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis:
After their final exams, Yoshino and Kirishima head to Yokohama to meet Yoshino's cousin, Tsubaki Akashigata, who recently moved from Kyoto. Reuniting after a long time, the three—Yoshino, Tsubaki, and Kirishima, who tagged along—explore the city together. They enjoy reminiscing and chatting about trivial things as they stroll through Yokohama. However, their fun is interrupted when Yoshino gets a call from school and has to leave, leaving the other two behind.

Kirishima seizes the moment and invites Tsubaki on a casual date. Alone together, they find themselves inside the glowing Ferris wheel at night. In this private, quiet space, Kirishima turns to Tsubaki and asks her an important question.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis:
Returning to Japan after living abroad, Nao Shioda lands a job as a TV announcer. She crosses paths with Kirishima, her ex-boyfriend from the past. In front of their friends, the two pretend to be strangers, but when they find themselves alone, Kirishima gently speaks to Nao and hands her his contact information.

Meanwhile, Yoshino and Kirishima travel to Osaka. While there, Yoshino reconnects with Shoma after a long time apart. Coincidentally, Nao also arrives in Osaka to attend an event, setting the stage for their paths to cross once more.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis:
From her seat on the bus, Nao spots Kirishima and Yoshino walking together. Unable to ignore them, she gets off at the next stop to follow. However, it's Yoshino who approaches Nao first. The two women begin to talk, and the conversation inevitably turns to their shared connection: Kirishima.

Nao reveals to Yoshino some of Kirishima's past that Yoshino had no idea about. Meanwhile, Nao faces trouble of her own. Her ex-boyfriend, Ozu, has uncovered secrets about her past and her previous relationship with Kirishima, gaining leverage that could impact her future. With this power, Ozu makes a troubling demand of Nao—one that could change everything.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: The semi-criminal group holding grudges against Yoshino and Kirishima, along with Azami Suou, had gathered under Ozu’s command. While Kirishima was with Nao, Yoshino spotted Ozu and his group and decided to carry out a plan on her own. Upon learning about Yoshino’s situation, Kirishima reluctantly contacted Shoma, the only person he could turn to in Osaka, to entrust Nao to him and head toward Yoshino. During this time, Kirishima called Yoshino, and the two made a significant "bet."
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis:
Kirishima finds himself in the crowded chaos of a fireworks festival, while Yoshino and a group of delinquents gather nearby. Yoshino chases after Oz, who has been abducted by Naoya, while Kirishima blends into the crowd and launches a surprise attack on the delinquents. Targeted due to the incident involving Shiori Akaza, Yoshino is spotted by Naoya and faces imminent danger. Kirishima continues to take down the delinquents one by one, but a mysterious and dangerous figure, Azami Suo, suddenly appears before him.

"Where is Yoshino Somei?" Azami asks Kirishima. But what is Azami's true objective...?
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Azami's true intentions for searching for Yoshino and the words Minami said to Shoma before leaving remain shrouded in mystery as Azami and the others disappear without a trace. Left behind, Kirishima and Yoshino confront Ozu, who has been captured, demanding he settle Naoya's scandals and promise never to interfere with them again. Despite Ozu's skillful maneuvering, always stopping just short of breaking the law and avoiding creating any vulnerabilities, Kirishima sets a trap for him. With the case resolved, Kirishima earns the right to be Yoshino's boyfriend and enthusiastically presses forward, only for Yoshino to propose a certain challenge to him.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: After visiting the Somei family grave, Kirishima is invited to the Somei group, where he spends a pleasant time. The group enjoys a barbecue together, sharing stories about young Tsubaki, who looked strikingly similar to Kirishima. Renji, one of Tsubaki's few close friends, reminisces about the past and shares nostalgic tales with Yoshino and Kirishima. However, the atmosphere becomes tense when Hotei returns from work. Summoned to the basement by Renji, Kirishima and Shoma are questioned about the uproar involving semi-outlaw groups that occurred in the Kansai region, a matter that also entangled Yoshino.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: After a tumultuous visit to her hometown, Yoshino and Kirishima return from Osaka to the Miyama residence in Tokyo. They thought their usual daily life would resume as always, but from the very next day, Yoshino starts ignoring Kirishima. She alters her schedule to avoid him when going to school, ignores him when he speaks, and offers no response even when he cooks for her. A rare moment of distress overtakes Kirishima, who sits in the rain in front of the annex where Yoshino is staying. What is the reason Yoshino continues to ignore Kirishima...?
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis: Yoshino Somei è una liceale nata e cresciuta in una famiglia di yakuza, il che non le ha però impedito di vivere una vita tranquilla e pacifica, almeno fin quando non incontra il suo fidanzato scelto dalla famiglia, Kirishima Miyama!
info.title: Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: Amuro Ray, waiting to start in the final battle of A Baoa Qu, sits in his RX-78-2 Gundam while the other forces are already fighting. He recalls many of the battles he has fought until now before launching.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century, after the Gryps Conflict: a video tape which is sent to Kamille Bidan by Argama chief engineer Astonaige Medoz. On the video Astonaige wishes him a quick recovery and it also contains a video scene from a battle training at which Kamille participated during the Gryps Conflict.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Future Century: Domon Kasshu is practicing Tai Chi with the God Gundam. However, suddenly Rain Mikamura appears in the Rising Gundam and attacks him!
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: It is revealed that several people leaked information about the Gundam Development Project to the Zeon Forces because Jamitov Hymem dislikes it. Afterward, a ruined MS-14A Gelgoog is shown floating in space after a group of MS-14F Gelgoog Marine and MS-06F Zaku II mobile suits attack the La Vie en Rose. To counter them, a woman named Defrah Kar pilots the RX-78GP03S Gundam "Dendrobium Stamen".
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: Quess apparently used the NZ-333 α Azieru to severely damage Hathaway Noa's RGM-89 Jegan. Afterwards Amuro Ray in his RX-93 ν Gundam has a Newtype reaction to her and confronts her.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: Cosmic Era: The YMF-X000A Dreadnought Gundam battles with several ZGMF-600 GuAIZ. Although Prayer Reverie tells them that he doesn’t want to fight, they continue and one of them slams him in an asteroid. Suddenly, a ghost appears.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: After Colony: A figure in a spacesuit (Heero Yuy) is setting bombs, then fades to Gundam engineer Doctor J, apparently imprisoned. He talks to a shadowy visitor about history and his young protege as the person in space suit tries to escape the facility he has just sabotaged.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Cosmic Era: In a secret ZAFT desert base, the Aile Strike Gundam faces off against several GINN OCHER Types.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: In space there lies a giant mobile armor called the Psycho Weapon and it's decimating the EFSF fleets so it's up to 3 Zeta Gundams to destroy the huge weapon.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: Judau is assigned to protect/escort the space transport ship Jupitris II on his (probably also his girlfriend Roux Louka's) birthday. While on the recovery missions he encounters Neo Zeon forces pursuing an AMX-004 Qubeley Mk-II.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: A Baoa Qu, the grounds of the final battle of the One Year War. As the scars of war remain fresh in the battlefield, novice Federation pilot Hiden surveys the area in a RB-79 Ball.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: Quattro Bajeena boards his RMS-099 Rick Dias for a battle simulation to transfer combat data to the mass-production model. The data personnel has some fun with him, turning the Rick Dias's monitor red, revealing his own old Zaku from his "Red Comet" days as his opponent.
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: As the AEUG attempt to enter the atmosphere for the drop operation on Jaburo, they come under attack by the Titans' RMS-108 Marasai mobile suits. An orbital battle ensues.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: SD Gundam: As evil Zaku bandits terrorize the country of Ark, Rekka Musha Gundam comes to the rescue chasing their leader Mazaku for the Scroll of Light he had stolen.
episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.synopsis: Universal Century: "Challia Bull was found to have the attributes of a Newtype during his activities in the Jupiter Energy Fleet. While doubtful of his own abilities, he is recruited and assigned by commander-in-chief Gihren to serve in Char Aznable's combat unit under Kycilia's command. Even as he senses the girl he met, known as Lalah Sune, to be something of a Newtype, the fierce combat with the Federation ace-piloted Gundam changed his convictions."
episodes.title: Episodio 15

info.synopsis:
I Gundam Evolve sono dei cortometraggi, in computer grafic, celebrativi di uscite di particolari kit in plastica. Infatti vengono venduti in bundle coi rispettivi modellini a cui fanno riferimemto.
Gundam Evolve I RX-78-2: un collage degli scontri sostenuti dall'RX-78-2 durante la guerra di un anno, mentre il collage è stato ottenuto con gli spezzoni dei film cinematografici, la sola parte in CG riguarda gli ultimi secondi del cortometraggio, dove si assiste al lancio di Gundam dalla Base Bianca. Decisamente misero come corto. Venduto in bundle assieme ala seconda edizione del Perfect Grade dell' RX-78-2
Gundam Evolve II RX-178 MKII: Test di combattimento simulato nello spazio su due modelli di RX-178, più una lunga carrellaa sul quello che nasconde sotto la corrazza l'RX-178. Venduto in bundle con al prima edizione del Perfect Grade dell'RX-178.
Gundam Evolve III GF-13-017 NJ II God Gundam: Esibizione di Tai-Chi da parte del God Gundam. con piccolo scambiodi opinioni tra Domon e Rain a bordo del Rising Gundam. Molto divertente per chi avrà visto G Gundam. Commemorativo dell'uscita del God Gundam versione Master Grade.
Gundam Evolve IV: Il Mobile Aemor Gundam Dendrobium difende la stazione spazile La Vie En Rose dall'assalto di una squadriglia di Gelgoog Marine. Il migliore degli Evolve, ricco d'azione e curato dallo stesso staff di Gundam 0083. Venduto in bundle con la prima edizione del Gundam Dendrobium HGUC 1/144
info.title: Gundam Evolve

episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver salvato alcuni uomini rinchiusi in una prigione, il cui direttore aveva il sadico passatempo di dare la caccia ai detenuti cui permetteva di tentare la fuga, Lupin si reca in un piccolo Paese del Sud Est asiatico, Zufu, per mettere le mani sul tesoro dell'ultima famiglia reale, da poco spodestata da un colpo di Stato guidato dallo spietato e sinistro generale Cacciateste. Il tesoro in questione però si trova su di un'isola resa inespugnabile da un sofisticato sistema cibernetico che uccide all'istante chiunque tenti di avvicinarsi alla cassaforte. info.synopsis: Lupin e Jigen si trovano al matrimonio del loro amico Goemon, che sposerà una giovane donna di nome Murasaki Suminawa. La sua famiglia possiede un ricco tesoro che sarà donato a Goemon subito dopo la cerimonia. Il prezioso tesoro è da secoli oggetto di desiderio del clan dei ninja di Fuma. Quest'ultimo giunge alla cerimonia nel tentativo di impossessarsi del ricco bottino, ma Lupin, Jigen e Fujiko fortunatamente impediscono la riuscita del furto. Il clan decide comunque di rapire la giovane sposa, chiedendo come riscatto un costoso vaso. Qualcosa però va storto, il nonno rifiuta il riscatto, e allora toccherà a Lupin e alla sua squadra salvare la ragazza e riportare tutto alla normalità. L'ispettore Zenigata, credendo Lupin ormai morto, decide di licenziarsi dal lavoro, ma un giorno, un suo amico poliziotto gli mostra una foto che lo ritrae al matrimonio di Goemon. Zazà, allora, insospettito, decide di riprendere il suo servizio, mettendosi immediatamente sulle tracce dell'invincibile ladro. Il nostro caro ispettore avrà finalmente la possibilità di incastrare Lupin una volta per tutte? Ma soprattutto, Lupin e i suoi riusciranno a proteggere l'inestimabile bottino dalle mani dei ninja?
info.title: Lupin III - La cospirazione dei Fuma (ITA)

episodes.synopsis: On the airplane flight back to Tokyo, Miyuki meets and befriends a young boy who seems to be traveling alone. Natsumi has been training with the JSDF Rangers and is on her way back to Tokyo as well. But when Miyuki arrives at Tokyo, a man tries to take the boy, and given the boy’s reaction, it looks like abduction. Miyuki gets the boy back, and makes a run for it by car, but the guy pursues in a black sedan representative of the Yakuza mafia.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: As Miyuki and Natsumi get settled back at Bokuto Station, they have to deal with Randy, a billionaire’s 12-year old son who has been pursued by the Yakuza.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: Bokuto station gets excited after Detective Tokuno brings over some taiyaki from a popular shop. But the shop is having trouble as someone has been moving cars off the road and stacking them against the wall.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: While on routine traffic duty, Aoi and Yoriko spot a girl looking for something in the bushes, but when they are on the way back, they realize they have a big iguana in the back seat! The girl happens to be the owner of the lizard; Miyuki and Natsumi escort the girl back to her apartment which is full of reptiles. One of them, named Shou-kun, is a large snake which takes a liking to Miyuki, and hijinks arise when the duo returns to Bokuto, and the girl finds out Shou-kun has gone missing!
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: A string of car break-ins has been going on at different public parking lots, and the Chief of Bakuto Station puts everyone on alert. But this time the guy who has been responsible finds a baby that was neglectfully locked in a car. The mom goes into a panic when she comes back and finds her car broken into and the baby missing.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: A police officer comes out of retirement to help out with things in Bokuto Station. Apparently the officer knows Aoi from some previous officer work, and since Aoi is still cross-dressing as a woman, the officer tries to turn Aoi into a man by giving him and the entire department some special training. Aoi doesn’t want to change his ways, but he and Natsumi stick with the training.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: A taxi cab has been taking advantage of women who have gotten drunk and needed rides home by driving them away from the district and robbing them. Bokuto station has taxi inspections, but are unable to find the culprit. Miyuki uses her detective knowledge to guess a lead on the taxi’s next hit, and Natsumi decides to get drunk as her tactic.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Miyuki and Natsumi realize in all these years, they know very little about their chief’s personal life when they receive a visit from someone that could be his daughter.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Yoriko has been feeling a bit down over her singleness and getting set up on dates by her mom to guys she could care less about. While Miyuki and Natsumi get assigned on a burglary case, Yoriko and Aoi get to give a class presentation on traffic safety to some kids who also discover she is single and make fun of her. She finds a fortune-teller who is somehow able to recognize her problems, but learns soon afterwards of that woman's fate and questions what to do next.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: Bokuto Station receives a visit from a research company who is hoping to facilitate the police officer's tasks with some of their latest and greatest robots. They have Miyuki demonstrate manipulating a large robot that could be used for disaster rescues, and Natsumi gets to dress up in a body suit that boosts her muscular power. The robots are demonstrated at a convention but something goes wrong when someone named Doctor Suu shuts them down and brings in another robot.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Ken watches a popular Korean TV drama and gets inspired to write a love letter confession to Miyuki, but has a really hard time finding the right circumstance to do so.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Detective Tokuno of the Criminal Affairs division visits the Chief for a friendly game of Go. Although the Chief always loses, Natsumi decides maybe there is a way for the Chief to win this time and rallies the Traffic department to challenge the Criminal Affairs division to a friendly game of baseball. While the teams play, Tokuno and Chief have their own Go battle again. But where there's baseball, there is bound to be the vigilante hero, Strike-Man!
episodes.title: Episodio 12

episodes.synopsis: Illegal garbage dumping hits the Bokuto district. Miyuki and Natsumi help Yoriko and Aoi investigate an abandoned recycling plant that has been overrun with trash, but Yoriko and Aoi have heard rumors that it is haunted.
episodes.title: Episodio 13

episodes.synopsis: A white sedan knocks over a woman and her dog. The woman is unconscious but the dog manages to grab a bite out of the suspect's clothing. Miyuki and Natsumi find the dog at the crime scene. Meanwhile, Detective Tokuno reports that a bank has been robbed. Miyuki and Natsumi take the dog with them and find the white sedan that was involved in the hit and run, converging with Tokuno's group. However, the suspects have fled into a large costume parade nearby, so it'll take some animal instinct to figure out who are the culprits.
episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.synopsis: A film group wants to chronicle the daily life of a Bokuto Traffic department. After following the girls, the Chief, and Ken around, they conclude that the footage is rather droll and routine, so the director comes up with a plan. Miyuki and Natsumi are to be in the final scene, but while they pose, they spot a man on a rooftop about to jump.
episodes.title: Episodio 15

episodes.synopsis: Chief informs the gang of a possible bomb threat at the Riverside Mall. The bomb is set to go off during a major shopping event that involves families and kids. Miyuki, Natsumi, Yoriko, and Aoi are assigned to search for the bomb, but they must wear mascot costumes and blend in with the festivities. Miyuki gets to wear the Mushroom costume, and she befriends a five-year-old boy and his younger brother. The younger brother makes off with a car model from a raffle but the older one tells him to return it since it's stealing but they freak out when Nakajima arrives at the scene. Will they find the bomb in time, and what will the boys do?
episodes.title: Episodio 16

episodes.synopsis: Natsumi catches a cold and has to stay home to recover. The illness gives Natsumi some really wild dreams including going to a fancy restaurant but realizing they are out of food, and confronting her old nemesis, Strike-Man. Meanwhile, Miyuki and the Bokuto gang search for a Spiderman like guy who has been breaking into apartments.
episodes.title: Episodio 17

episodes.synopsis: The Bokuto girls (including Aoi) go on a beach trip for their day off. They also meet up with Saori who is stationed in the North side. Nakajima tries to visit the beach to work on his relationship with Miyuki, or at least see her in a swimsuit, but he gets stuck in traffic. After some volleyball and fun in the water, the girls learn from a beach vendor that some peeping tom has been taking pictures and posting them on the Internet, so the girls help Saori scout for culprits, and set up Miyuki, Natsumi, and even Aoi-chan as bait.
episodes.title: Episodio 18

episodes.title: Episodio 21

info.title: You're Under Arrest: Full Throttle

episodes.synopsis: "Redline" is about the biggest and most deadly racing tournament in the universe. Only held once every five years, everyone wants to stake their claim to fame, including JP, a reckless dare-devil driver oblivious to speed limits with his ultra-customized car - all the while, organized crime and militaristic governments want to leverage the race to their own ends. Amongst the other elite rival drivers in the tournament, JP falls for the alluring Sonoshee - but will she prove his undoing, or can a high speed romance survive a mass destruction race?
episodes.title: Redline

info.synopsis: In un futuro dove tutti i mezzi di trasporto funzionano con una sistema antigravità, le vecchie automobili che viaggiano su pneumatici sono delle rarità e vengono utilizzate soltanto come mezzo di intrattenimento in delle corse senza esclusione di colpi. Ogni cinque anni si svolge la più dura e distruttiva gara automobilistica dell'universo, la REDLINE, che attira tutti i migliori e più intraprendenti piloti da ogni angolo dello spazio conosciuto. JP è un pilota squattrinato, disposto a truccare le gare a cui partecipa pur di pagare i suoi debiti e continuare a correre. Nonostante abbia vinto pochissime gare, il suo look retro e gli spettacolari incidenti da cui esce sempre indenne, gli procurano il sostegno di numerosi fan in tutta la galassia. Dopo aver perso clamorosamente la YELLOWLINE contro la bella Sonoshee McLaren, JP si rassegna ad una lunga degenza in ospedale per poi tornare alla solita vita. Quando all'improvviso una folla di giornalisti fa irruzione nella sua camera d'ospedale con una notizia clamorosa. Dopo il ritiro di due partecipanti e grazie al voto del pubblico, JP si è qualificato per partecipare alla prossima REDLINE. Il problema è che la corsa si svolgerà su Roboworld, un pianeta che non permette intromissioni e che è disposto a mettere in campo tutta la sua potenza militare pur di fermare la famigerata gara. Ma JP non si lascia scoraggiare dai pericoli a cui potrebbe andare incontro e decide di mettersi in gioco. Al volante della sua Trans Am, si metterà sulla linea di partenza accanto a Sonoshee e agli altri scatenati concorrenti e farà di tutto pur di realizzare il suo sogno: tagliare il traguardo della leggendaria REDLINE in prima posizione!
info.title: Redline

info.synopsis: Durante i caotici viaggi del Capodanno Interstellare, con tutti i biglietti esauriti, il fumettista Li Ha dovette accontentarsi di un taxi spaziale così malconcio che la portiera non si chiudeva nemmeno bene. Quello che doveva essere un semplice trasferimento si trasformò in un'incredibile avventura: nello stesso giorno, Li Ha si ritrovò improvvisamente sposato e padre di due figli!
info.title: No. 7 West Mars St.

info.synopsis: Marie è la figlia di un nobile caduto in disgrazia e vive da sempre all'ombra della sorella. I suoi capelli rossi sono pieni di nodi e non possiede nessun abito a parte quelli logori che utilizza durante i lavori. Mentre lei conduce una vita da serva, la sorella Anastasia attira l'attenzione del conte Granado, uno degli uomini più belli e ricchi del regno che si vocifera sia un misogino dal carattere difficile. L'uomo, che si è innamorato a prima vista della ragazza, le chiede di sposarlo ma durante il viaggio verso il luogo del matrimonio avviene un incidente e Anastasia muore. Ora Marie, dopo che il padre ha già impiegato tutta la dote del conte e non ha modo di ripagarlo, si ritrova costretta a sostituire la sorella... ma a quanto pare c'è stato un malinteso fin dall'inizio riguardo la proposta di matrimonio!

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki Kenji, a young AD Police member who always ignores his partner and solves each case by himself. Many of his partners have been wounded by that attitude. This time, his partner Paul is seriously injured during a mission and rumors says that nobody will team up with him anymore. One night, he goes to his usual bar and has a huge fight with a German named Hans.
episodes.title: Episodio 1

episodes.synopsis: Even though Kenji got a new partner he hardly talks to Hans. This pissed Hans off to the point that Hens stops talking to Kenji too. During this "cold war", Kenji's ex-partner Paul who is involved in a voomer case on the way to a new hospital. The Voomer driver goes wild and turns into a Nano Stampede. Even though Kenji and Hans don't speak a word, they rescue Paul through perfect teamwork. Hans is treated by a beautiful nurse, Agemi, he met earlier at the hospital.
episodes.title: Episodio 2

episodes.synopsis: A.D Police set off on a mission to destroy the illegal voomer factory. However, the Syndicate's main henchman Liam sets up a trap that stops the AD police action. Kenji is angry at the Syndicate and decides to complete the mission by himself again. The only person who follows him without a word is Hans. The two of them complete the mission and the trust between the partners seems to be growing stronger now.
episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.synopsis: The only time Kenji feels relaxed is when he is with his girlfriend Kyouko. Kyouko is a college student in music school and she is going to have a graduate concert in the museum near her home. Kenji promises that he will be there but Kyoko is kidnapped by voomers that day! Kenji takes risky action trying to save Kyoko. The other AD Police members stop his dangerous actions and set up a plan to rescue Kyoko. This time, Kenji finally realizes how important teamwork and trust in your teammates is.
episodes.title: Episodio 4

episodes.synopsis: Liam gives himself up to the police. He claims that he made mistake at work that he is afraid that his boss, Mesion, will punish him so he is willing to trade industry secrets with the police in exchange for his safety. AD Police believe him and set up a trap for the latest Genom voomer delivery car that Laim said Meison are targeting. However what they don't know is that this is Liam's plan to take over Genom's newest voomer.
episodes.title: Episodio 5

episodes.synopsis: The AD Police successfully seized many illegal voomers from the Paker Syndicate. It was all because of Jose's great trap that the mission went so well. But Liam gets very angry and kidnaps Jose's wife and kid. Liam asks to trade Jose's family's safety for the illegal voomers.
episodes.title: Episodio 6

episodes.synopsis: AD Police is keeping an eye on Liam after they got information that Liam secretly trading with Genom Tower. Kenji and the other members set up a mission to capture Liam and chase him into Genom tower. Suddenly a mysterious old man shows up to protect Liam and set him free.
episodes.title: Episodio 7

episodes.synopsis: Kenji's only relative-his grandfather visit AD police office looking for Kenji. But Kenji refuse to meet him and sneak to the bar "Lost City". Kenji's teammates later visit Lost City and try to convince him to meet his grand father. But Kenji decline there is no need to bring up memories of his past. Hans told Kenji that he lost all of his memories in an accident and he always feel anxious about who he really is and to his past. After listening to confess of his past, Kenji finally changed his mind.
episodes.title: Episodio 8

episodes.synopsis: Hans is seriously injured in a battle with voomer. Kenji taught Hans will never recovered but to his surprise, Hans recover in an amazing speed! Kenji suspicious about who Hans really is and checking Hans's blood to find the truth.
episodes.title: Episodio 9

episodes.synopsis: AD Police member happily welcome Hans back to office but Kenji is holding an complex feeling. The first job after Hans come back is tracing Liam who stole the latest bio-voomer earlier.
episodes.title: Episodio 10

episodes.synopsis: Liam is tracked into a corner by AD Police but he escape into reactor in the center of Tokyo. He pulls out the control rod of atomic reactor and decides to bring Tokyo with him to hell. Kenji are ready to give up his live to stop Liam but Hans knock him down and entered the reactor instead. Hans assured he is a bio-voomer and transfigure to a ugly bio-voomer to kill Liam.
episodes.title: Episodio 11

episodes.synopsis: Kenji rush to Genom Tower to rescue Hans who is captured by Genom. Kenji and Hans are about to escape to somewhere Genom couldn't reach them but it is too late. Hans's transfiguration getting more serious and the chairman of Genom-Umihara is attacking Kenji for Kenji knows too much. Hans and Kenji team up again to destroy Umihara but Hans has run out of his strength and pass over in silence..
episodes.title: Episodio 12

info.synopsis:
Ambientato qualche anno prima di Bubblegum Crisis Tokyo 2040, A.D. Police narra le vicende della divisione speciale di polizia di Mega-Tokyo, creata per controllare i Boomer impazziti nella città.

L'ufficiale dell'A.D. Police Kenji Sasaki si trova di fronte a un grave dilemma: ha appena perso un altro partner per mano di un boomer rabbioso. Il giorno dopo essere stato messo in aspettativa, gli viene assegnato un nuovo compagno, il poliziotto tedesco Hans Kleif. La cosa strana è che Kenji aveva dato un pugno a tradimento a Hans in un bar la sera prima. Non solo Kenji deve affrontare il compito quotidiano di controllare i Boomer, ma ora deve anche fare i conti con il suo nuovo partner.

info.synopsis: Akihito Abikura è uno studente liceale del secondo anno che si ritrova una nuova insegnante di inglese appena laureata. Hiyori Hiwamura ha una personalità timida, con una voce debole e scarsa prestanza fisica che quasi invoglia a proteggerla. Purtroppo, però, il suo carattere e la sua voglia di impegnarsi vengono fraintese dai suoi studenti: in breve tempo riceve l'appellativo di "insegnante spaventosa", e iniziano a girare voci che maledica le persone quando si arrabbia utilizzando uno strano quaderno pieno di post-it. Un giorno, Akihito, rimasto a scuola, vede Hiyori insegnare in un'aula vuota con solamente un animale di peluche davanti a lei... e rimane scioccato da quale sia la realtà. Alla fine l'insegnante non è affatto spaventosa, ma solamente incompresa, e Akihito è deciso ad aiutarla a superare la sua timidezza.
info.title: Yowayowa Teacher

episodes.synopsis: In this world, everyone can use magic… and in a land called the Clover Kingdom, two young men, Asta and Yuno, strive to become the Wizard King, the greatest of all magic users. Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at a church in Hage, a village in the boonies, and lived as brothers from that day onward. For some reason, however, Asta never developed the ability to use magic, even when Yuno had already mastered wind magic. Now, at last, the boys are turning fifteen, the age at which children receive their own grimoires. Asta has high hopes that receiving his grimoire will awaken his latent ability to use magic, but when the time comes…
episodes.title: Asta e Yuno

episodes.synopsis: The grimoire that Yuno received was a legendary grimoire with a four-leaf clover. A bandit named Revchi comes to steal it, and Asta comes to Yuno’s rescue.
episodes.title: La promessa del ragazzo

episodes.synopsis: Asta and Yuno spend six months training for the upcoming Magic Knights Entrance Exam. Everyone seems to think Yuno is sure to pass, but worries that Asta is just wasting his time.
episodes.title: Alla capitale del regno di Clover

episodes.synopsis: Asta and Yuno head toward the colosseum in the royal capital for the Magic Knights Entrance Exam, while looking around and admiring all the things they’ve never seen before.

episodes.title: Il Toro Nero

episodes.synopsis: As a new member of the Black Bulls, Asta is thrilled to receive his very first private room, even though it’s tiny. Everything Asta sees as Magna shows him around the squad’s base is new and exciting to him.
episodes.title: L'altro nuovo membro

episodes.synopsis: The Magic Knights: heroes that everyone in the kingdom looks up to and dreams of becoming one day. But the new recruit, Asta, has yet to do anything that seems like what a Magic Knight should be doing, as he’s stuck doing random chores.
episodes.title: Go! Go! Prima missione!

episodes.synopsis: On Yami’s orders, Asta and Noelle go on their first mission with Magna to hunt wild boars. They successfully complete the mission and go to Saussy Village to meet with the mayor, Seyhe.
episodes.title: Bestie

episodes.synopsis: Asta, Noelle, and Magna are doing their best to protect the villagers of Rayaka from the ice magic user Heath and his underlings, but Asta’s attacks don’t seem to be working, and Magna’s magical powers are running low.
episodes.title: Il protettore

episodes.synopsis: It’s payday! Vanessa takes Asta and Noelle to the castle town of Kikka for a little shopping, where they encounter many familiar faces along the way.
episodes.title: Un giorno in città

episodes.synopsis: All eyes are on Asta as he and Sekke race to capture a purse-snatcher. Meanwhile, Yuno’s first Golden Dawn mission takes him to an unexpected place.
episodes.title: L'Imperatore Magico ha visto tutto

episodes.synopsis: Yuno never expected his last-minute detour to involve such tragedy. It’s up to the Golden Dawn to get the bottom of their mission’s many mysteries.
episodes.title: L'Imperatore Magico ha visto tutto, continuo

episodes.title: Dungeon

episodes.synopsis: Asta, Yuno, and their squadmates must take on daunting foes on their way to the heart of the dungeon, but Luck remains dead set on fighting all alone.
episodes.title: Compagni

episodes.synopsis: The Diamond Kingdom’s secret weapon wields more powerful magic than anyone has seen. The Golden Dawn team is all but decimated. Can he be defeated?
episodes.title: Il distruttore

episodes.synopsis: The Clover Kingdom’s Magic Knights reach the dungeon’s treasure hall, but another daunting battle keeps them from reveling in their victory for long.
episodes.title: Tu nei miei ricordi

episodes.synopsis: The dungeon itself turns against the Magic Knights as they fight to escape—and to keep a badly wounded Asta alive. Mars remembers how he came to be.
episodes.title: Crollo e salvataggio

episodes.synopsis: The royal capital is under siege! The Magic Knight squads must set aside their quarrels and come together to defend the Clover Kingdom and its people.
episodes.title: Disordini nella capitale

episodes.synopsis: The best of the Magic Knights—plus Asta and Noelle—fight the hordes of undead beseiging the royal capital. Noelle suffers a crisis of confidence.
episodes.title: Danza magica selvaggia

episodes.synopsis: Asta’s showdown with the man behind the capital invasion takes a turn. King Clover bemoans the Wizard King’s absence in his kingdom’s time of need.
episodes.title: Il Leone Vermiglio

episodes.synopsis: Rades wasn’t the only invader—and the others are more powerful, their sights set far higher. The Magic Knights fall victim to a Spatial Magic spell.
episodes.title: Blackout

episodes.synopsis: What has become of Fuegoleon Vermillion? Yuno struggles to recover from his battle with the witch, while Asta’s cursed wounds threaten to do him in.
episodes.title: Avversità

episodes.synopsis: The masterminds behind the invasion reveal themselves, though their motivation remains unclear. Asta spends quality time with one of his heroes.
episodes.title: Belve ferite

episodes.synopsis: As life slowly returns to normal in the royal capital, the Wizard King reaches an uncomfortable conclusion about the invasion and how it came about.
episodes.title: Luce

episodes.title: La donna che mi ha conquistato il cuore

episodes.synopsis: Old friends and fellow squad members reminisce about Asta: his humble beginnings, his craziest battles—and underlying it all, his burning ambition.
episodes.title: Strada

episodes.title: Il mago degli specchi

episodes.synopsis: Asta and Gauche scour the countryside in search of Nean’s children, who have fallen into the clutches of a ruthless monster thirsty for their magic.
episodes.title: Tracce nella neve

episodes.synopsis: As expected, there were bigger baddies behind the abduction of Nean’s children. Luckily Sister Theresa is on hand to join the fight for their freedom.
episodes.title: Germogli di trifoglio

episodes.synopsis: Gauche reflects on his past as he struggles with protecting Marie versus helping Asta in his downhill battle against Sally’s mutant magic monster.
episodes.title: Un giorno sarà utile a qualcuno

episodes.synopsis: Backup arrives for Asta’s showdown against the leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Asta must push past his limits to pull off a tricky technique.
episodes.title: Magia di luce VS Magia di tenebre

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls seem to be on the losing end of an epic clash between two highly gifted magic users. Gauche has an idea that could turn the tables.
episodes.title: La luce del giudizio

episodes.synopsis: Three elite members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun pay a visit to their comrade Licht, prepared to make Yami and friends pay for what they’ve done.
episodes.title: I tre occhi

episodes.synopsis: The Third Eye battle rages on, now with three talented Magic Knight captains providing backup. Licht reveals an intriguing tidbit about Asta’s gear.
episodes.title: Il ragazzo senza magia

episodes.synopsis: The Wizard King calls a meeting of the Magic Knight captains. Asta has barely enough time to recuperate before being summoned to the royal capital.
episodes.title: La riunione dei comandanti dei Cavalieri Magici

episodes.synopsis: There’s a traitor among the captains! Marx’s spell reveals who’s been collaborating with the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Julius considers his next move.
episodes.title: Il saluto del trifoglio

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls relax at the beach as they gear up for their secret mission. Noelle’s showing off new swimsuit—if Asta would pay any attention.
episodes.title: Un racconto dalla spiaggia nera

episodes.synopsis: Noelle’s magic is indispensable for the fight ahead. A new friend has some tips to help improve her magic control, but Noelle has a long way to go.
episodes.title: I progressi della ragazza dell'acqua

episodes.synopsis: The eccentric high priest of the Underwater Temple makes it crystal clear that the Black Bulls won’t get their hands on the magic stone that easily.
episodes.title: Il tempio sottomarino

episodes.synopsis: It’s the misfit magicians of the Black Bulls up against the fearsome fish-masked Temple Mages. Noelle faces a surprising foe, and Asta uses his head.
episodes.title: La battle royal del tempio

episodes.synopsis: A dangerous interloper has muscled his way into the Underwater Temple fight, and it’s up to Yami’s crew to deal with him and his mind-boggling might.
episodes.title: La schietta palla di fuoco e il fulmine selvaggio

episodes.synopsis: While Asta has his hands more than full with Vetto, Gauche must think outside the box as he takes on some of the beastly mage’s talented minions.
episodes.title: Il ragazzo incapace di arrendersi

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls and their new Underwater Temple friends pull out all the stops to take down Vetto, but there’s far more to him than meets the eye.
episodes.title: Risveglio

episodes.synopsis: Vanessa and Finral find inspiration as a tattered remnant of Black Bulls bands together to tackle the mighty Vetto—who shows no sign of slowing down.
episodes.title: L'unica arma

episodes.synopsis: Finral and Vanessa reflect on their pasts while guiding Asta’s attacks, but they’ll need to change it up to keep the furry fiend Vetto on his toes.
episodes.title: Disperazione VS Speranza

episodes.synopsis: Asta’s never-give-up attitude has a impact on his fellow Black Bulls. Vetto recalls his youth, while Yami comes to a realization and takes action.
episodes.title: Oltre i limiti

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls recover after their fight against the Eye of the Midnight Sun took everything out of them—literally. Asta gets himself back on track.
episodes.title: Fine del combattimento, fine della disperazione

episodes.synopsis: The Clover Kingdom can barely breathe a sigh of relief before the border village of Kiten is attacked by the Diamond Kingdom’s most fearsome generals.
episodes.title: Provare di essere nel giusto

episodes.synopsis: Yuno and the Golden Dawn take point in Kiten, while the Black Bulls’ contingent tend to the survivors. Yami has a little chat with William Vangeance.
episodes.title: Il più forte vince

episodes.synopsis: William Vangeance opens up to Yami about his past, while Finral stands up to his brother Langris. Julius questions the Diamond Kingdom’s intentions.
episodes.title: Dietro la maschera

episodes.synopsis: Asta gets shocking news from the top doctor in the entire Clover Kingdom. His fellow Black Bulls rally behind him, scrambling to find a way to help.
episodes.title: Mai più

episodes.synopsis: A flashback to Asta’s days learning the sword under a skilled mage with a complicated past—and a dangerous future. Noelle hopes he can help Asta now.
episodes.title: L'uomo chiamato Fanzell

episodes.synopsis: Fanzell meets Asta again once Asta’s joined the Black Bulls, but this time he’s far from alone. In the present, Vanessa seeks a cure for Asta’s curse.
episodes.title: L'uomo chiamato Fanzell, continuo

episodes.synopsis: Noelle’s contingent is intent on infiltrating the Forest of Witches. They’ll need mighty magic to get past the relentless security and meet the queen.
episodes.title: Infiltrati

episodes.synopsis: Faced with the destruction of her forest and the deaths of her “daughters,” the Queen of Witches helps Asta to help her fend off two invading armies.
episodes.title: Decisione sul campo di battaglia

episodes.synopsis: Together, Asta and friends must find a way to extinguish the flames of Fana’s deep-seated hatred—and the literal flames of her fire spirit familiar.
episodes.title: Le fiamme dell'odio

episodes.synopsis: Fanzell goes up against two of his former pupils, now among the Diamond Kingdom’s top-ranking generals—and one of them wields dangerous new powers.
episodes.title: L'espiazione dei disertori

episodes.synopsis: Mars is on a mission to save his childhood friend, even as it becomes increasingly clear that only Asta’s anti-magic stands a chance against her.
episodes.title: Il mondo promesso

episodes.synopsis: Fana shares what she remembers of her past, but her touching reunion is interrupted by a relentless foe with an insatiable appetite for magic.
episodes.title: Crescere insieme

episodes.synopsis: Asta undergoes a startling transformation, fighting like a man possessed. When he learns who’s behind this change, he also learns its shocking price.
episodes.title: Proprio niente

episodes.synopsis: Vanessa recalls her painful past as she faces off against the Queen of Witches, who is manipulating Asta into killing her squadmates before her eyes.
episodes.title: Il filo rosso del destino

episodes.synopsis: Asta and his squadmates learn about the origins of the Eye of the Midnight Sun, Vanessa finds her place, and the Black Bulls make their way back home.
episodes.title: Sono a casa

episodes.synopsis: Klaus helps Yuno and Mimosa get caught up on the Magic Knight Squads’ encounters with the Eye of the Midnight Sun. Yami meets with the Wizard King.
episodes.title: Il segreto dell'Occhio Magico nella Notte Bianca

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls attend the Star Festival, where Asta and Noelle are roped into a double date. The mood is right to tell each other how they feel.
episodes.title: Appuntamento doppio alla festa

episodes.synopsis: Captains Yami and Jack the Ripper are ready to settle their long-running rivalry, while their newest squad members are desperate to rein them in.
episodes.title: Battaglia mortale?! Yami VS Jack

episodes.synopsis: Captain Charlotte of the Blue Rose Knights thinks back to her past, but not before she and Vanessa battle it out in more than one ill-advised contest.
episodes.title: La malinconia della fanciulla delle spine

episodes.synopsis: The Wizard King announces the latest Magic Knight squad rankings and reveals the two top star-earners, while King Clover introduces a bold new plan.
episodes.title: Due nuove stelle

episodes.synopsis: Mereoleona Vermillion, the new captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, takes the squad (and a few Black Bulls) along for training in a strong magic region.
episodes.title: L'imbattuta leonessa senza corona

episodes.synopsis: Asta attempts to tap into his mysterious dark powers so he can make it to Mereoleona’s hot spring training camp. Noelle learns about her late mother.
episodes.title: Fuoco di Sant'Elmo

episodes.synopsis: Magic Knights from every squad gather for the test that will determine who’ll be a Royal Knight. The vice-captain of the Purple Orcas causes a stir.
episodes.title: L'esame per la selezione dei Royal Knights

episodes.synopsis: Round 1 of the tournament sees Asta and Mimosa teaming up for a heated battle against three skilled senior Magic Knights. But what happened to Xerx?
episodes.title: Il fiore della risoluzione

episodes.synopsis: The tournament continues as Magna and Sol fight alongside the conceited Kirsch Vermillion and Finral takes a risk with teammates Leopold and Hamon.
episodes.title: Scontri feroci

episodes.synopsis: A mystery mage with a tortured past joins the competition with unconventional but powerful magic, taking everyone by surprise—friend and foe alike.
episodes.title: Il mago X

episodes.synopsis: It’s Noelle chance to prove to her brother Solid that she’s far from a failure, while Alecdora Sandler takes out his jealousy on the upstart Yuno.
episodes.title: Rancore

episodes.synopsis: Narcissist royal Kirsch takes offense at having to battle Asta the commoner, but Asta has some new tricks up his sleeve that catch Zora off guard.
episodes.title: La trappola del popolano

episodes.synopsis: It’s not looking good for Asta’s team; even anti-magic Asta has his hands full guarding their crystal from squadmate Magna’s powerful new Flame spell.
episodes.title: Il signor delinquente VS il muscoloso

episodes.synopsis: The long-awaited showdown between Finral and Langris has come around at last, and gentle Finral must prove himself to his cutthroat little brother.
episodes.title: Fratellino speciale VS fratellone fallito

episodes.synopsis: The Magic Knights question Langris’ sanity as he challenges Asta to a fight in the middle of the tournament. Zora recalls his Magic Knight father.
episodes.title: La vita di un certo uomo

episodes.synopsis: In a break from all the action, a forest-foraging Charmy falls victim to a mind-altering mushroom that gives her vivid visions of Clover Clips past.
episodes.title: Petit Clover! L'incubo di Charmy - puntata speciale!

episodes.synopsis: The semifinal bout between Asta and Langris comes to a grim conclusion. Luck has a plan that could give his team the edge over Aqua Deer captain Rill.
episodes.title: Imprimitela a fuoco nella memoria

episodes.synopsis: It’s the final match in the Royal Knights Selection Test. Rill seeks inspiration for his masterpiece; Yuno and Bell are ready to try something new.
episodes.title: I vincitori

episodes.synopsis: Yami suggests a leisurely bath to get Asta out of his funk. While there, he reminisces about his first battle alongside the masked William Vangeance.
episodes.title: Relazione nuda

episodes.synopsis: Yami tells another tale of his younger days in the Magic Knights: a top-secret mission given to him and William Vangeance by the Wizard King himself.
episodes.title: Yami e Vangeance

episodes.synopsis: Those who have passed the Royal Knights Selection Test assemble for the first time to be briefed on their mission: defeat the Eye of the Midnight Sun.
episodes.title: Nascono i Royal Knigths

episodes.synopsis: The Royal Knights relocate to the royal capital in preparation for their attack on the floating dungeon in Gravito Stones. Klaus warns of enemy spies.
episodes.title: Incursione nel covo dell'Occhio Magico

episodes.synopsis: Gauche, Gordon, and Grey are holding down the fort when the hideout is attacked by some familiar faces. The trio must work fast to defend their home.
episodes.title: Il rifugio del Toro Nero

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls learn why their home base keeps changing shape; that same power is put to the test against members of the Eye of the Midnight Sun.
episodes.title: Scontro magico assurdo

episodes.synopsis: Fierce fighter Mereoleona takes on Raia of the Third Eye and his wide range of formidable Copy Magic spells as Zora tries to figure out how they work.
episodes.title: Merereona VS Raia della slealtà

episodes.synopsis: It’s a battle for the ages as the Clover Kingdom’s mightiest mage takes on the dynamic leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun—and an unexpected guest.
episodes.title: Imperatore magico VS Capo dell'Occhio magico

episodes.synopsis: The battle rages on between the Wizard King and Licht, who holds a kingdom’s worth of innocent people hostage. Julius recalls his greatest motivation.
episodes.title: Julius Novachrono

episodes.synopsis: Yami rushes to Julius’ side as the Wizard King’s battle with Licht draws to a close. Yuno’s team approaches the center of the terrorist’s hideout.
episodes.title: Un nuovo futuro

episodes.synopsis: A look into the origins of Licht’s hatred of humans and the complicated ways by which the Third Eye—and Licht as he is today—came to be.
episodes.title: Trasmigrazione

episodes.synopsis: It’s Yami versus the elves: first Marx and Owen, then an elf-possessed Charlotte who seems bent on destroying the royal capital and everyone in it.
episodes.title: Il comandante del Toro Nero vs La rosa scarlatta

episodes.synopsis: Royal Knights and disgraced mages alike encounter friends and squadmates whose bodies have been taken over by reincarnated elves. Can Black Asta help?
episodes.title: Inferiorità schiacciante

episodes.synopsis: The vice-captain of the Crimson Lion Kings, now a reincarnated elf, turns on his squadmates with powerful Air Magic. A mighty beast awakens at last.
episodes.title: Il Leone dormiente

episodes.synopsis: Mereoleona is left to face five powerful elf enemies alone, putting her “undefeated” title to the test. Mimosa’s Royal Knight teammates turn on her.
episodes.title: Il patto disperato verso la salvezza

episodes.synopsis: Asta confronts his rival, Yuno, one of many Golden Dawn members to have been taken over by elves. Licht is spurred to action, as are Yami and Finral.
episodes.title: Non perderemo contro di voi

episodes.synopsis: Even remote little Hage Village is not immune from the chaos overtaking the Clover Kingdom. Asta and Yuno are determined to fight for their hometown.
episodes.title: La vita del villaggio al confine estremo

episodes.synopsis: As Asta and Yuno battle a Poison Plant mage, Sister Lily recalls the letters they would send home. The priest is in a bad way; can Asta’s sword help?
episodes.title: Due miracoli

episodes.synopsis: As the elves set their sights on the royal capital, bent on destroying all humankind, Asta’s newest sword may be the key to driving them out for good.
episodes.title: Il rilascio della sfortuna

episodes.synopsis: After a chance encounter with their squadmate Luck, Magna and Vanessa go to extremes in a struggle to free their friend from a crazed elf’s clutches.
episodes.title: Fulmini di rabbia contro i compagni

episodes.synopsis: Asta and friends stop by the ruined Black Bulls hideout to check in with their squadmates before pursuing the reincarnated elves to the royal capital.
episodes.title: Lacrime di gioia

episodes.synopsis: Fueled by Charmy’s magical meals, Asta’s team detours to defend Hecairo on their way to the royal capital and picks up a trio of most unlikely allies.
episodes.title: La via della vendetta e quella dell'espiazione

episodes.synopsis: Yami and Finral take on possessed members of the Golden Dawn; Noelle and Nozel must defend their siblings when the Silva family home is under siege.
episodes.title: Battaglia decisiva al castello di Clover

episodes.synopsis: Noelle must think outside the box to gain the upper hand in the pitched battle at House Silva. Thoughts of her mother help her push past her limits.
episodes.title: La principessa danzante sul campo di battaglia

episodes.synopsis: While Mimosa, Kirsch, and En were protecting the Vermillion residence from the elves, Langris, who had reincarnated as an elf, had arrived at the castle. He goes after the king’s life but Finral shows up with Captain Yami and Captain Jack. Despite knowing the difference in power between him and his younger brother, Finral continues to support Captain Yami and Captain Jack in this fight against Langris. Finral goes for a risky attack which injures him, and…
episodes.title: I fratelli della magia di spazio

episodes.synopsis: As the battle at Clover Castle continues the Shadow Palace appears. Captain Yami and Captain Jack get a bad feeling about this, so they try to infiltrate the palace, but Magic Knights who had reincarnated as elves keep getting in their way. Then Asta and the other Black Bulls as well as Rades, Sally, and Valtos arrive! Asta tries to undo the reincarnation spell that’s been cast on the Magic Knights, but then the Captain of the Coral Peacocks, Dorothy Unsworth, who has also reincarnated as an elf appears before them!
episodes.title: Il toro adirato nello scontro tra titani!!

episodes.synopsis: Due to Captain Dorothy’s magic, Vanessa, who can use magic to alter fate and Charmy, who can use magic to recover mana had disappeared. Asta and the remaining Black Bulls have lost the bulk of their defense and are now struggling against Gauche and Marie’s combo magic being used against them. Meanwhile, Vanessa and her team try to figure out how to get out of Captain Dorothy’s dream world.
episodes.title: Gli occhi nello specchio

episodes.synopsis: Vanessa and her team are able to figure out how to leave Captain Dorothy’s Glamour World due to quick thinking on Sally’s part, but it’s easier said than done. But then Luck gets an idea to help them out. Meanwhile, Asta continues to try to undo the reincarnation spell on Gauche and Marie but can’t even get close to them. Henry sees this and decides to make a great sacrifice…
episodes.title: Umani in cui credere

episodes.synopsis: After their last battle, Asta and some of the others decide to chase after Captain Yami and some others who had already headed into the Shadow Palace. However, the elves get in their way. It was then that Captain Fuegoleon and Captain Mereoleona, both who had just awakened, showed off their true powers. Asta and the others are happy to have their help, but then notice that the door to the Shadow Palace closing. In order to get Asta and his group into the palace, the other Black Bulls hold off the elves outside.
episodes.title: Assalto al palazzo reale oscuro

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls fight off the elves as Asta and the captains head into the Shadow Palace. However, they start to feel cornered from being so run down from one battle after another. It was then that Yuno had finally arrived to save them, bringing other Magic Knights he found throughout the land with him. Yuno hears the situation from Charmy and decides to head into the Shadow Palace, too. However, the entrance was now closed. But then, his pendant starts to react in a strange way…
episodes.title: Gli ultimi invasori

episodes.synopsis: Yuno manages to enter the Shadow Palace with his pendant and runs into Patry and the others. However, his pendant is immediately stolen. Now, all of the necessary magic stones have been collected and the elves’ wish was supposed to come true. However, an uninvited guest appears before them: A devil from another world. They find out everything that happened between the elves and humans were actually a part of his plan all along. Yuno can’t hide is astonishment at how powerful the devil is as he tries to fight it, and then Asta and Mimosa also arrive!
episodes.title: Eminenza grigia

episodes.synopsis: “When the owner of the four-leaf grimoire is filled with despair, the five-leaf clover grimoire will be born.” Patry is filled with despair after learning he had been manipulated by the devil all this time and turns into a dark elf. He then starts attacking Yuno and Asta, fueled by nothing but hatred and malice. Somehow, becoming a dark elf had made Patry even stronger, which gives Yuno and Asta an even harder time fighting him. Then Captain Nozel appears before them. Nozel happens to have the best magical attribute to fight against light magic, mercury magic.
episodes.title: Il nemico naturale definitivo

episodes.synopsis: The strange little black bird Nero, who kept following Asta around, suddenly appears before Finral, who had just finished fighting with his brother Langris, and demands that he take them to the Demon’s bones back in Hage Village. Finral is obviously startled that Nero’s suddenly speaking human words but obliges and takes Nero to the bones and witnesses an unbelievable sight. We will finally find out the true events that befell the elves 500 years ago! Meanwhile, back at the Shadow Palace, the devil’s eerie magic fills the room.
episodes.title: Il momento di infrangere il sigillo

episodes.synopsis: To stop the devil from leaving the Shadow Palace Asta, Yuno, and Patry, who had just regained his senses, head to the top floor. Once they get there, they are greeted by the first Wizard King, Lumiere Silvamillion Clover and the one who serves him, Secré Swallowtail。Secré is the true form of the mysterious bird, Nero, and she is a mage that uses a rare magic called sealing magic. She uses her magic to break the seal on Licht, and they are able to witness the true leader of the elves, Licht, and his true powers. An epic battle begins so that Licht and Lumiere can get revenge against the devil.
episodes.title: Riuniti attraverso il tempo e lo spazio

episodes.synopsis: Licht and Lumiere fight against the devil using incredibly powerful magic. But the devil has incredible regeneration powers and quickly heals himself, making him difficult to defeat. Asta witnesses the two powerful mages fighting and tries to figure out if he can use his anti-magic in a more useful way. He’s able to use a new power, but it’s so powerful that he’s having a hard time controlling it. Meanwhile, Yuno also awakens to a new power… Asta and Yuno, who both aspire to be the future Wizard King, pull off an impressive attack in front of the first Wizard King!
episodes.title: L'attacco finale

episodes.synopsis: The Shadow Palace begins to shatter, but Asta and the others manage to escape. Meanwhile, the elves continued to attack the kingdom because they still didn’t know the truth. Asta is the only one who can undo the resurrection, but it won’t be easy to save all of them at once. Patry then frees Vangeance, who’s sleeping inside him, so he can use his world tree magic and Licht can use his magic that connects him with all of the elves and Asta is able to undo the resurrection of all the elves at once. Finally, the long battle is coming to an end.
episodes.title: Alba

episodes.synopsis: The battle involving the whole Clover Kingdom is finally over. But because of the battle, the kingdom was heavily damaged, so the Magic Knights were busy trying to repair everything. Meanwhile, someone rather unexpected shows up in front of Asta and the others and states three problems that will come up for the Clover Kingdom. Asta and the others are surprised, but just as they were told, someone showed up to try to judge Asta and his devil power.
episodes.title: Tre problemi

episodes.synopsis: Asta, who has the power of the devil, and Secré who used forbidden magic and turned into Nero, were called before the Magical Parliament to be judged. Asta maintains his innocence, but Damnatio Kira will do everything he can to probe that Asta is guilty. In order to save Asta and Secré, Yami shows up with the Black Bulls and they cause a ruckus. While the Black Bulls cause trouble, a few others show up…
episodes.title: Più Nero del Nero

episodes.synopsis: Because she used forbidden magic, Nero survived for centuries. In the back of her mind, memories from long ago start to replay in her head. From when Nero was still called Secré and when Secré first met the most powerful and talented mage in the Clover Kingdom, Prince Lumiere. They become friends with Licht and the other elves, but due to the evil plans of a devil, the humans end up killing all of Licht’s comrades. Because of that, Licht ends up turning into a demon and Lumiere finds him in that state. What will he have to do to protect the ones he loves?
episodes.title: Le reminiscenze di Nero - Prima parte

episodes.synopsis: After using forbidden magic in the fight against the devil, Secré turns into a bird and ends up spending centuries all alone. During that time, she ends up meeting Asta, who ends up with Licht’s grimoire that has a different devil residing in it. Patry ends up reviving due to resurrection magic, and then he becomes the leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun and vows to get revenge. This was all according to the devil’s plan and Secré uses her sealing magic to free Lumiere and Licht so they can finish off the devil once and for all along with Asta. The battle comes to an end, and Secré now begins her new life as a member of the Black Bulls.
episodes.title: Le reminiscenze di Nero - Seconda parte

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls return to where their base originally was. Henry has to return the Raging Bull back into their hideout, but apparently, that takes some time. Meanwhile, Yami tells the Black Bulls to go find the magical beasts that escaped from the hideout. They had run away when Rades and the others had attacked the hideout and had been wandering around the forest ever since. There was even a chance that they had returned to their feral states. Their fear comes true, as one Black Bull is attacked after another.
episodes.title: Il ritorno

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls were ordered by the Wizard King to investigate the devils. Yami takes Asta and Nero and goes to talk to Captain Charlotte of the Blue Rose Knights, since she has experience with forbidden magic and curses. But when they get there, Charlotte suddenly runs off somewhere and they’re all in shock. Charlotte had memories of while Charla took over her body and fears that Yami had found out her true feelings and she ended up panicking. But then, she makes a decision.
episodes.title: La confessione della Rosa Blu

episodes.synopsis: In order to find out more about the forbidden curse, Asta, Gordon, Grey, and Gauche head to Gordon’s house, since he comes from a family of famous curse mages. Once they get there, they can’t help but show their wariness towards Gordon’s family. But in the end, they end up finding out valuable information while they’re there. Meanwhile, Noelle goes to talk to the Dorothy Unsworth, the Captain of the Coral Peacocks, after her brother tells her to talk to her to find out the truth behind their mother’s death. Dorothy tells her the name of the devil who had killed her mother, and the same name is spoken by Gordon’s grandmother. That devil’s name is…
episodes.title: Indizi

episodes.synopsis: Thanks to Gordon’s father, Asta and the others were able to find out that there might be clues surrounding the devils in the Heart Kingdom and manage to get permission to enter the kingdom due to the fact that Mimosa had gone there previously to study overbroad. Asta, Noelle, Finral, Mimosa and Nero head to the Heart Kingdom. Asta and the others initially enjoy their trip there, but something that Langris told Finral had been bugging Finral. Suddenly, Asta and the others are faced with a rather unexpected trial. Will Asta and the other Black Bulls be able to obtain information on the devils?!
episodes.title: Verso il Regno di Heart!

episodes.synopsis: Asta and the others manage to meet with the queen of the Heart Kingdom, Loropechika, who had also been chosen by the water spirit, Undine. They are able to confirm that the devil’s curse that they spotted in the Heart Kingdom was originating from Loropechika herself and that the devil was in the Spade Kingdom. Meanwhile, Vanessa, Magna, and Luck went to investigate the Diamond Kingdom and find it in ruins after a single mage of the Spade Kingdom had annihilated them. In order to defeat this devil, Loropechika asks Asta and the others for their help…
episodes.title: Diavolo Magicula

episodes.synopsis: The Magic Knight Squad Captains decide to have a meeting about the problem with the devils that ended up involving the whole Clover Kingdom. Asta and the others who were in the Heart Kingdom were also summoned and they disclose the information they gathered in front of Julius, Damnatio, and the Captains. After hearing what Asta and the others had to report, Julius tells everyone what they need to do in order to deal with the devil Megicula.
episodes.title: La nuova riunione dei comandanti dei Cavalieri Magici

episodes.synopsis: Asta and Yuno are given permission to go home to Hage for a little while. Asta was being called a devil in the papers, but Father, Sister Lily, everyone at the church, as well as the people who even used to make fun of Asta and Yuno because they were orphans, welcomed them home with open arms. Asta and Yuno see that they had gone down the right path and all their hard work wasn’t for nothing, and then…
episodes.title: Rinnovata determinazione

episodes.synopsis: The Black Bulls get a sudden visit from Mereleona and she drags them to the strong magic region of the Yultim Volcano. There, the Crimson Lion Kings, as well as their captain, Fuegoleon, and his younger brother Leopold, were waiting for them. Asta and Noelle remember the hot springs they had visited on their previous trip there. Finding new resolve, Magna, Luck, Charmy, Gordon, and Nero all decide to train in the fiery underground cave of the volcano!
episodes.title: Il risveglio del Leone

episodes.synopsis: As Asta and the others were chasing the creature that lived in the cave beneath the Yultim Volcano Trail, they happened upon a dungeon. They were then ordered to explore the dungeon by the royal capital, so they split into groups and went in. They head in with Leopold and Vice Captain Randall, but those two end up running into the creature from earlier. They work together but cannot defeat the monster, which makes Leopold feel useless. At that moment, Leopold remembers the strange feeling he felt when he was fighting the elves, and…
episodes.title: Il risveglio del Leone - Seconda parte

episodes.synopsis: Asta and Noelle return to the Black Bulls’ hideout only to get taken away by Mereoleona again. The place they were brought this time was the Vermillion estate. Waiting for them there was Captain Fuegoleon, Kirsch, Mimosa, and the sister who looked after the children at the church in Nean, Sister Theresa, who was also known as the former Magic Knight, the Crimson She-Leopard. Asta and Noelle wait in anticipation, wondering if they are going to get a new mission, but what Fuegoleon actually tells them is…
episodes.title: Tutti noi qui riuniti

episodes.synopsis: Though their betrothal was decided between their families, Finral tries to become a better man for Finnes’ sake. However, his impulse to instantly hit on any girl he happens to see doesn’t seem to get better, so he asks Asta to help him train… But they end up going to a mixer. Meanwhile, the members of the Blue Rose Knights want to help Charlotte out with her chances at love and invite Yami to a mixer-like setting at the same pub. What will result from both of these mixers?
episodes.title: Hai la mia mente, il mio cuore e la mia anima

episodes.synopsis: Noelle and the other Black Bulls head to Racquey to do some training, when Noelle hears a mysterious voice. Shortly after, the Black Bulls are reunited with Kahono and Kiato. The siblings ask them for help and they head down to the Underwater Temple. There, Gifso explains that a creature called the guardian has gone berserk, so in order to quell its rage, Kahono and Kiato need to present it with their song and dance. Gifso asks the Black Bulls to act as their bodyguards and Yami appoints Noelle and Finral for the job.
episodes.title: Un nero racconto dalle profondità del mare

episodes.synopsis: Asta and the other Black Bulls continue their training in order to face off with the devil. Charmy is trying to use her cotton magic and her Sheep Cooks to create food to enhance her friends’ mana, but she realizes she lacks training. She then decides to seek out someone who can help her. Meanwhile, Gordon is also unhappy with his inability to help his friends, so he decides to go off to train on his own.
episodes.title: Charmy, cent'anni di fame, e Gordon, mille anni di solitudine

episodes.synopsis: Zora wanders off from the rest of the Black Bulls and heads back home to his village to visit his father’s grave. He then meets a boy from his village named Ina. Ina idolizes Zara who became the first peasant to become a Magic Knight and was training hard in hopes to be like him someday. But then, Ina is confronted by a noble boy named Kaito, who was visiting the village on vacation, and is told that his dreams are futile. Enraged, Ina tries to fight Kaito, but Zora stops him. Zora then tells Ina a little story.
episodes.title: Le orme di Zara

info.synopsis: Arihito Atobe era un impiegato stremato dalla vita d'ufficio, schiacciato dal peso delle continue richieste del suo inflessibile superiore, Kyōka Igarashi. Un tragico incidente in autobus mette fine alla sua esistenza terrena, solo per catapultarlo nel misterioso Paese del Labirinto, un mondo governato da mostri e regole avventurose. Qui, ogni reincarnato deve scegliere un lavoro e unirsi a una gilda per sopravvivere. Arihito, deciso a non ripetere gli errori della sua vecchia vita, rifiuta di seguire ancora una volta Kyōka e il suo ritmo implacabile. Invece, sceglie la classe del tutto inusuale di “rearguard”, un ruolo di supporto che opera nelle retrovie potenziando gli alleati con abilità di attacco, difesa e guarigione. Mentre costruisce la sua nuova squadra, composta da compagne che imparano presto ad apprezzare il suo stile calmo e premuroso, Arihito scopre che il vero coraggio non sta nel combattere in prima linea, ma nel saper sostenere chi gli sta accanto. Tuttavia, le insidie dei labirinti minacciano di trascinarlo di nuovo in una lotta spietata, questa volta non solo per la sopravvivenza, ma anche per la sua libertà.
